firm_data.firm_description: Vella, Carbone & Vinson, LLP is a law firm that provides legal services to individuals and families, focusing its practice on Elder Law, Estate Planning and Probate, Special Needs Planning, and Trust and Estate Litigation. Based in Delmar, New York, the firm serves clients throughout the Capital Region.
notable_facts: The firm has a team of award-winning attorneys with more than 85 years of combined legal experience.

email.subject: AI for Vella, Carbone & Vinson, built for firms like yours
email.body:
Hi Jessica,

With your team managing Elder Law, Estate Planning, and Probate work across the Capital Region since 2016, you're handling complex cases that demand both precision and client trust. That's exactly where most smaller firms feel the pressure to compete.

I lead business at Lucio, an AI platform built for law firms that face BigLaw demands with leaner teams. We recently raised $5M, and firms across 9 jurisdictions have chosen us over Harvey because we focus on the realities of smaller practices: precision, client trust, and efficiency.

Having completed successful pilots on the East Coast, we're now arriving in the Albany area to meet regional firms. I'd be happy to stop by your office to share how, as ex-lawyers ourselves, we're helping similar firms compete with BigLaw.

Worth 20 minutes?

Vasu
Lucio
